notes:
Summary: Mid-market product org building in-app onboarding copilots (guided flows) to reduce time-to-value for new users. Interested in Hosted API for quick POC, then evaluate Dedicated for predictable latency & cost once volume grows. Focus: streaming + tool-calling (invoke internal ticketing and billing APIs).

Pain / why Redwood:
- Current prototype uses multi-request OpenAI streaming; tail latency variance kills UX during long flows.
- Token costs spiking on multi-turn sessions — need token caps and predictable per-session cost.
- Want built-in routing/fallback: if primary model is overloaded, auto-fallback to compatible variant.

Technical requirements (customer):
- Latency SLO: 95th pct end-to-end streaming latency <200ms for 1-3s chunks (target 150ms).
- Throughput: 150-300 concurrent onboarding sessions at peak; average session ~12-20 turns.
- Cost sensitivity: cap per-session tokens to keep monthly token spend ~3-6M tokens.
- Model prefs: open LLaMA-like variants acceptable; prefer quantized variants for Dedicated.
- Tool calling: secure callouts to internal ticketing API + feature-flag service; must support function/tool schemas and streaming.
- Security: SSO (SAML), audit logs, KMS for keys, optional EU data residency for EU customers.

Timeline / recent activity (CRM timeline snippets):
- 2026-01-18: Initial inbound via pricing form. Nora (AE) assigned.
- 2026-01-24: Intro demo (hosted API features, streaming demo). Fireflies ff_2026-01-26_8732 transcript.
- 2026-01-29: Deep-dive with Product + Infra (Liam attended). Discussed concurrency patterns, token budgeting.
- 2026-02-04: Security questionnaire submitted. Follow-up meeting; recording ff_2026-02-04_9126.
- 2026-02-10: Pricing call — asked for Hosted POC proposal + committed Dedicated pricing ballpark if POC passes.

POC acceptance criteria (agreed):
- Two-week hosted POC simulating average traffic (peak concurrency 250).
- Demonstrate streaming stability: 95th pct streaming latency <200ms for interactive segments.
- Token cap enforcement: implement and validate per-session token caps; cost stays <= $0.0006 per token (client target).
- Tool-calling end-to-end: secure function calls to staging ticketing API with no auth leakage.

Notes from calls / direct quotes:
- "We need the onboarding chat to feel instantaneous; anything with big lag kills completion." — Head of Product
- "If you can guarantee consistent latency and a path to Dedicated pricing, we'll push to procurement." — VP Eng

Integration notes / engineering asks:
- Wants SDK examples for streaming + tool-calls (JS mobile/web).
- Wants sample load profile JSON and a recommended batching/kv-cache settings.
- Needs SAML SSO test account and a short security call with Redwood security (30–45m).

Commercials / pricing convo:
- Interested in a hosted POC (credits + short-term slots) then 12–24m Dedicated commit if POC meets SLOs.
- ARR expectation for first year if Dedicated: $75k–$180k (depends on commit and support tier).

Next steps (explicit):
1) Send Hosted POC proposal (Nora) with token cap enforcement details and monitoring dashboard links.
2) Engineering: provide sample streaming SDK snippets + load profile (Liam).
3) Security: 30m call to review retention/residency + SAML checklist (schedule week of 2026-02-15).
4) Run POC (2 weeks) -> measure SLOs -> pricing for Dedicated.

Open questions / blockers:
- Security needs explicit retention windows + EU residency proof for a subset of customers.
- Need clearer cost model at 3–6M tokens/mo and pricing for auto-scaling bursts.
- Want a fallback policy example (how Redwood chooses compatible variant when capacity constrained).

- Champion: Head of Product (Eva Morales). Procurement owner: CFO (Bryce Han).
- Recommended demo focus: end-to-end streaming with tool-calls, show rollback to cheaper variant, show cost dashboard with per-route token caps.
